source_snapshot.procedure: List AGFHC recipes, run `pcie_lvl2` and `dma_lvl2` separately, inspect both bandwidth results.
source_snapshot.criteria: Each AGFHC run returns Status: PASS and actual bandwidth exceeds the target in its log.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL owner-installed AGFHC but runs only pcie_lvl2 over insecure SSH; omits dma_lvl2, targets and complete dual-run evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores sequential PCIe and DMA recipes, independent thresholds, no-load window, monitoring and recovery.

old_problem: AGFHC version/recipe semantics, PCIe/DMA topology, per-run target values/units/windows and health limits are absent. DeepSeek covers only pcie_lvl2 and could falsely treat one engine as both tests. Source clearing would remove AER/DMA evidence, while sustained I/O needs isolation and recovery.
disposition_reason: The source explicitly defines two non-substitutable recipes and two identical acceptance structures. Compatible AGFHC, topology-specific targets and measurement windows are runtime Project Configuration; ED-15 prevents invented thresholds. Both full runs are retained sequentially in a dedicated no-load window with independent Status/actual/target and link/DMA/GPU health evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2057, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2058 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00012-V002 / 14a312d6dbafd0d1 was directly read from XLSX.
pcie_lvl2 and dma_lvl2 exercise related but distinct transfer paths; neither result, status nor threshold can cover the other.
Each recipe must report its own AGFHC Status: PASS and measured bandwidth strictly higher than the signed target with matching unit/window/direction.
Targets depend on PCIe generation/width/topology and recipe implementation, so they are package inputs and not inferred from observed DUT performance.
Baseline/post link speed/width, AER, DMA/GPU, thermal and power evidence rejects false results caused by downtrain, errors or competing load; no logs are cleared.
No AGFHC list/PCIe/DMA run, sustained I/O, login, monitoring, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Independent AGFHC PCIe and DMA bandwidth qualification
test_case.purpose: Run owner-approved AGFHC pcie_lvl2 and dma_lvl2 sequentially on the mapped platform, verify each independent Status and actual-versus-target bandwidth, and prove no PCIe/DMA/GPU/link/thermal regression under sustained I/O.
required_package: Exact row-2057 variant plus SUT/GPU/PCIe/DMA/driver/firmware topology identity
Approved AGFHC binary/version/checksum and exact pcie_lvl2/dma_lvl2 availability/semantics
Per-recipe target bandwidth, unit, transfer direction, measurement window and output schema
Dedicated no-concurrent-load maintenance authorization and protected host access
Link speed/width, AER, DMA/GPU, thermal/power abort limits and non-repeating recovery
test_case.test_command: STRESS-GATED; preserve logs and capture topology, AGFHC identity/list, PCIe link speed/width, AER, DMA/GPU, thermal and power baseline. Prove a dedicated no-load window and obtain authorization. Run approved `pcie_lvl2` once, retaining full stdout/stderr separately, exit, Status, actual/target/unit/window and monitoring; stop on any failure. After health remains valid, run `dma_lvl2` once with the same independent evidence. Compare each recipe only to its signed target and recheck complete link/error/GPU/thermal/power state. Do not clear logs, truncate output, substitute one recipe or auto-rerun.
test_case.expected_result: Both pcie_lvl2 and dma_lvl2 independently complete with AGFHC Status: PASS, each measured bandwidth is strictly above its own approved target in matching units/window, and link speed/width, AER, DMA/GPU, thermal, power and system health remain within approved limits without competing load.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tool/recipes/topology/targets, full independent evidence for both runs, Status PASS plus actual>target for each, and clean post-health. FAIL on missing recipe, non-PASS status, actual<=target, unit/window mismatch, downtrain, AER/DMA/GPU error, thermal/power abort or instability. Missing target/package/approval is NOT READY; one run cannot yield partial PASS.
safety_gate: Sustained PCIe/DMA I/O requires explicit maintenance authorization, no competing workload and recovery access.
Run recipes sequentially once; monitor link/AER/DMA/GPU/thermal/power and stop on first invalid state.
Preserve full outputs and baseline/post logs; no log clearing, truncation or insecure access.
No automatic rerun or changed-recipe/target retry after failure.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and platform/GPU/PCIe/DMA topology
AGFHC checksum/version/list and signed per-recipe target/unit/window/schema
Complete pcie_lvl2 output/exit/Status/actual-target comparison and monitoring
Complete dma_lvl2 output/exit/Status/actual-target comparison and monitoring
Post-health/no-clear/no-rerun audit, failure recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On non-PASS, low bandwidth, downtrain, error or thermal/power anomaly, stop the active recipe and preserve full first-failure state. Quiesce AGFHC and use the approved service/link recovery under human control; do not run the second recipe after invalid health or rerun the failed one automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Two separate full recipe runs, signed targets and preserved health evidence replace DeepSeek's single-run subset and undefined acceptance without inventing performance thresholds.

blocked.reason: The dual-run method, evidence and recovery are complete; AGFHC/recipes, topology targets and limits are runtime Project inputs.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO TWO INDEPENDENT AGFHC PCIE/DMA RUNS; NO TOOL LIST/RUN, SUSTAINED I/O, LOGIN, MONITORING, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
